description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the JobTitleDao component within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It includes setup logic, multiple test methods for retrieving, deleting, and counting job titles, and references external classes and fixtures related to job titles and attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for the JobTitleDao data access object, validating various retrieval and deletion operations related to job titles in the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the JobTitleDao object and loading test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of all job titles and verifies expected titles are present.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Tests fetching job titles associated with specific employees and validates the results.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleListWithInactiveJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of job titles including inactive ones.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests deletion of specific job titles by ID and verifies the number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a job title by its ID and checks its name.

methods.name: testGetJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a job specification attachment by its ID and checks file name.

methods.name: testGetJobTitles
methods.description: Tests fetching job titles with filtering parameters and verifies counts and names.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Tests counting job titles with filtering parameters.
